source_read: All five official allergen PDFs (Standard, Counter, Kiosk, Drinks, Valerie; PV_ALLERGENS_Autumn_26, created 29 Sep 2026) re-downloaded on 2026-10-08 from the links on https://patisserie-valerie.co.uk/pages/nutritional-and-allergen-information (robots.txt checked with robots_rfc: page and cdn.shopify.com files allowed), 526 product rows. Marks read three ways that must agree: the text layer (Y/N/MC by header-word column), the cell fill colour from the vector drawing (pdftocairo -svg) and, once, rendered pixels at 200 dpi (11,900 marks: 18 text/fill disagreements, all held back). 'May contain' text tied to rows by the table's own borders (merged and wrapped cells).
held_back: 28 more dishes held back for their allergen rows (287 published before -> 259 with allergens): 11 Valerie-menu dishes with blank Lupin/Molluscs cells; Eggs Benedict (blank Peanuts), Pain Au Raisin (blank Milk, stray 'y'); 12 dishes where a mark's text and fill colour disagree (Mini Black Forest Slice, Almond Croissant, 5 Chai lattes, 2 Coconut matcha lattes, Salted Caramel Frappe Almond, 2 Oat frappes/shakes, Biscoff milkshake Oat); both Egg & Cress sandwiches (one recipe, code AUAT001, printed with and without egg). Held-back rows were looked at on the rendered pages (10 rows) to confirm the reason.
notes: 48 random published dishes (one per category plus random extras, seed 808) compared against the rendered PDF (header strip + row strip + 'May contain' cell, read by eye): contains, may contain (grid MC and text) and cereals all matched. Design decision: may contain = grid MC cells UNION allergens named in the 'May contain' column, because the guide's own grid and text disagree on many rows (of 497 readable rows, 186 name allergens the grid does not mark MC and 19 have an MC the text does not name); nothing dropped, nothing reconciled. A dish that contains one tree nut/cereal and may contain another shows the generic allergen (policy 2). 15 'Cinnamon Bun' drinks flagged name-implies-gluten were logged reviewed (flavour name; the same drink with oat milk is marked Oats). Dish-level ties are exact by construction: kcal and allergens are cells of the same row.
